summary: Issue #18: the isolated clean-Profile smoke copied ambient settings.yaml and never selected the DSV4-FVE route, so it ran the ambient agent-default-model (qwen38-207/qwen38-flash-next) instead of the vLLM/PTC selection. Implemented a test-only line-oriented no-YAML helper replaceAgentDefaultModel that deterministically rewrites only the top-level agent-default-model provider/model inside the disposable copied settings (defaults RLM_LIVE_PROVIDER=vllm, RLM_LIVE_MODEL=DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp, both overridable), plus an RLM_DSH_REPO_ROOT portability seam that resolves the authoritative harness root and validates apps/cli/src/bin.ts before launch; the live M1E test now asserts headless status 0 with bounded stdout/stderr tails, preserves every existing clean-Profile assertion, and asserts ambient settings/.credentials.yaml byte-unchanged in finally. Strict TDD: offline M2 Issue#18 test RED 1/1 then GREEN 1/1; offline profile-smoke 1 pass plus 2 live-gated skip; pnpm test 113 (111 pass, 2 skip); typecheck/build/check:memory/diff-check pass. Live was attempted with bounded diagnostics: (A) pre-fix environment-layout RED where the legacy three-level REPO_ROOT mis-resolved to D:/Source in the external worktree and the launcher required tsx there (fixed with RLM_DSH_REPO_ROOT pointing at the authoritative harness root); (B) provider deepseek -> headless exit 1 UNKNOWN_MODEL (pi-ai provider deepseek has no configured model) which is the live RED proving the wrong provider assumption; (C) authoritative provider vllm -> headless exit 1 NO_ADAPTER (no adapter registered for provider vllm; the UI provider-group label vllm is not a pi-ai-adapter-owned profile key). The live clean-Profile did not reach RLM_ACCEPT_OK, so no live PASS is claimed and Issue #18 stays open for the harness/settings-side model-profile gap.

summary: Successor correction for Issue #18 with an explicit accuracy note: the earlier instruction prescribed counting persisted tool calls by a wrong top-level event shape (row.name), but the installed DSH SessionEvent authority (packages/core/session/src/types.ts defining type=tool/call with data={turn,step,callId,name,arguments}, agent-loop session.append usage, and invariant event.data access) corrects it to row.type === tool/call AND row.data non-null object AND row.data.name === toolName. The live test correctly exposed the wrong oracle, so this successor also corrects the earlier mistaken environment conclusion (the wrong source DSH home produced UNKNOWN_MODEL/NO_ADAPTER) by using the coordinator-approved configured DSH home, referenced only generically with no concrete temp path. Fixes include: (1) replaceAgentDefaultModel now rewrites only the two provider/model lines and preserves every other block line byte-for-byte (the real settings add a two-space reasoningEffort child) while keeping LF/CRLF preservation and the missing/duplicate/malformed/unsafe rejection matrix; (2) countToolCalls uses the official nested data.name event shape, ignores torn/non-JSON lines, and returns zero for plain-text mentions and for a wrong top-level name shape; M1E selects the depth-0 main session with the structured counter, asserts at least two main rlm_eval calls, and asserts every delegationDepth greater than zero child session has zero rlm_eval tool calls. Strict successor TDD: RED for the reasoningEffort regression (malformed), RED for the nested data.name oracle (0 versus 1), then both GREEN; offline gates all pass. Final live evidence: the clean-Profile smoke PASSED against the correct configured DSH home with candidate defaults (provider vllm, model DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp): M1E headless exited 0 and emitted RLM_ACCEPT_OK, every main-session assertion passed, and every child session had zero rlm_eval tool calls; kernel-dispose live PASS and offline M2 Issue#18 PASS, 3/3 live tests PASS.
